summary.text: Lloyd Caulker is a write-in candidate with no party affiliation for the Florida House of Representatives, District 15, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Dean Black and Chadd Charland.
Ballotpedia lists his occupation as business consultant.

paragraphs.text: Caulker graduated from Seabreeze Senior High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Florida in 2002 and a D.O. from Saint Thomas Christian University in 2024, according to Ballotpedia.
He ran in the August 20, 2024 Democratic primary for Florida House District 14, finishing third with 4.6% of the vote behind incumbent Kimberly Daniels and Therese Wakefield-Gamble.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Caulker described himself as an entrepreneur and father based in Jacksonville, focused on business development and the shrimp and ethanol and renewable-fuels industries.
He said he supports lower taxes, small government, affordable housing, accessible health care and quality education.
